title: Opening: Monday. Dana's text (side quest: Saturday)
notes: Scene Book, Opening: Monday, section 4. Approved by Jim, Nov 21, 2026. The words are the Scene Book's.

It buzzes in the first time you check the phone or walk into the kitchen. JIM: if neither happens, it arrives at noon so the player still gets it. The Scene Book doesn't say what happens if you never do either.
"Not yet." only shows when you come back to an unanswered text. It's Claude's two words, so you can close the text again without re-recording "Didn't answer Dana."
The record keeps the time you answered: every record line carries its clock time.

msg.speaker: Dana, your friend

then.title: Saturday
then.objective: Dana: "Still on for Saturday?" You can answer now, later or never.

text: Still on for Saturday? Be honest if you're not. You bailed last time.

choices.label: "Work's been insane. I'll try."
result: It works. A thumbs up. Nothing gets harder today. Nothing gets better either.

effects.objective: You said you'd try. Saturday is still open.

choices.label: "I bailed. That's on me. I'll be there."
result: "ok. holding you to that." A promise you can keep or break.
choices.record: Owned the miss. Promise made: Saturday with Dana.
effects: proof:ownership:Owned the miss with Dana. Promise made: Saturday.

choices.label: Leave it on read.
result: It sits in the quest log. It's still there at lunch, and at five.

effects.objective: Dana asked about Saturday. Not answered.
